question: Should new standard StepFun and Step Plan setups now default to Step 3.7 Flash, replacing the Step 3.5 default deliberately retained when the model was added?
rationale: Both products support Step 3.7 and the implementation is narrow, but selecting it by default is a user-facing provider policy choice that repository history treated separately from model availability.

options.title: Adopt Step 3.7 defaults
options.body: Approve the shared default after the contributor supplies redacted fresh-onboarding proof for standard and Step Plan.

options.title: Keep Step 3.5 defaults
options.body: Leave Step 3.7 selectable without changing new-setup behavior if maintainers prefer the existing stability policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt Step 3.7 defaults
recommendation.body: Approve the shared default after the contributor supplies redacted fresh-onboarding proof for standard and Step Plan.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current default-path refactor and merged the most recent Step 3.7 contract work.
